moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Acrobatics

moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. If the user has no held item, this move has double power.

moves.name: After You

moves.longEffect:
The target will act next this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority.
If the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Alluring Voice
moves.effect: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.
moves.longEffect: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

moves.name: Ally Switch
moves.effect: User switches places with the friendly Pokémon opposite it.
moves.longEffect: User switches position on the field with the friendly Pokémon opposite it. If the user is in the middle position in a triple battle, or there are no other friendly Pokémon, this move will fail.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by two stages.
moves.longEffect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Ancient Power

moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

moves.name: Aqua Cutter
moves.effect: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.longEffect: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Aqua Step

moves.longEffect: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

moves.name: Armor Cannon
moves.effect: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
moves.longEffect: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Assurance
moves.effect: Power is doubled if the target has already received damage this turn.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target takes damage this turn for any reason before this move is used, this move has double power.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.effect: Never misses.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Aurora Veil
moves.effect: Reduces damage five turns, but must be used during hail.
moves.longEffect: Places the Aurora Veil effect on the user’s side of the field for the next 5 turns. If the weather is not Hail, or the weather is disabled by the effects of Cloud Nine or Air Lock, this move will fail. Any regular damage dealt to an affected Pokémon is reduced by ½. (If there are multiple Pokémon on the affected field, the reduction is ⅓.)

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Baneful Bunker
moves.effect: Grants the user protection for the rest of the turn and poisons any Pokémon that tries to use a contact move on it.
moves.longEffect: Grants the user protection for the rest of the turn. If a Pokémon attempts to use a move that makes contact with the user, that Pokémon will be poisoned. This move’s chance of success halves every time it’s used consecutively with any other protection move.

moves.name: Barb Barrage
moves.effect: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.
moves.longEffect: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.effect: Allows the trainer to switch out the user and pass effects along to its replacement.
moves.longEffect:
User switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. Stat changes, confusion, and persistent move effects are passed along to the replacement Pokémon.

The following move effects are passed:

* Aqua Ring
* both the user’s and target’s effect of Block, Mean Look, and Spider Web
* the curse effect of Curse
* Embargo
* Focus Energy or an activated Lansat Berry
* Gastro Acid
* Ingrain
* being sapped by Leech Seed
* being targeted by Lock-On or Mind Reader
* Magnet Rise
* Perish Song’s counter
* Power Trick
* Substitute; the doll’s HP is unchanged

The replacement Pokémon does not trigger effects that respond to Pokémon switching in.

moves.name: Beat Up
moves.effect: Hits once for every conscious Pokémon the trainer has.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts typeless regular damage. Every Pokémon in the user’s party, excepting those that have fainted or have a major status effect, attacks the target. Calculated stats are ignored; the base stats for the target and assorted attackers are used instead. The random factor in the damage formula is not used. Dark Pokémon still get STAB.

This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.

moves.name: Belly Drum
moves.effect: User pays half its max HP to max out its Attack.
moves.longEffect: User pays half its max HP to raise its Attack to +6 stages. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail.

moves.name: Bite
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Bitter Blade
moves.effect: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.longEffect: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Bitter Malice
moves.effect: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
moves.longEffect: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

During Hail, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.effect: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.
moves.longEffect: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.effect: Destroys Reflect and Light Screen.
moves.longEffect: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Brutal Swing
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately.

If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect.

If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Bullet Punch
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.effect: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Burn Up
moves.effect: Removes the user’s Fire type after inflicting damage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Removes the user’s Fire type after damage calculation. If the user is not Fire-type, this move will fail.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Ceaseless Edge
moves.effect: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.
moves.longEffect: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.

moves.name: Charm
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.
moves.longEffect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Chilly Reception
moves.effect: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.
moves.longEffect: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

moves.name: Circle Throw
moves.effect: Ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random.

If the target is under the effect of Ingrain or Suction Cups, or it has a Substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out. If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead.

moves.name: Clanging Scales
moves.effect: Lowers the user’s Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the user’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Clangorous Soul
moves.effect: User loses 33% of its Max HP. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage.
moves.longEffect: User loses 33% of its Max HP. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. Fails if the user would faint, or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed stat cannot go any higher.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.effect: Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Coaching
moves.effect: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
moves.longEffect: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

moves.name: Coil
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.
moves.longEffect: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.

moves.name: Cotton Guard
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by three stages.
moves.longEffect: Raises the user’s Defense by three stages.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Curse
moves.effect: Ghosts pay half their max HP to hurt the target every turn. Others decrease Speed but raise Attack and Defense.
moves.longEffect:
If the user is a Ghost: user pays half its max HP to place a curse on the target, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP every turn.
Otherwise: Lowers the user’s Speed by one stage, and raises its Attack and Defense by one stage each.

The curse effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Darkest Lariat
moves.effect: Ignores the target’s stat modifiers.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Destiny Bond
moves.effect: If the user faints this turn, the target automatically will, too.
moves.longEffect:
If the user faints before its next move, the Pokémon that fainted it will automatically faint. End-of-turn damage is ignored.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Detect
moves.effect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
moves.longEffect:
No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail.

Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move.

Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move.

The following effects are not prevented by this move:

* Acupressure from an ally
* Curse’s curse effect
* Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn
* Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits
* Imprison
* Perish Song
* Shadow Force
* Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Dire Claw
moves.effect: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.
moves.longEffect: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

moves.name: Disable
moves.effect: Disables the target’s last used move for 1-8 turns.
moves.longEffect: Disables the target’s last used move, preventing its use for 4–7 turns, selected at random, or until the target leaves the field. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, or if it already has a move disabled, this move will fail.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Draco Meteor
moves.effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.
notes: Lowers the user's Special Attack by two stages after damage; chain it with a switch or use once off a Choice item.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Dragon Dance
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage each.

moves.name: Dragon Darts
moves.effect: Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice.
moves.longEffect: Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Draining Kiss
moves.effect: Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.longEffect: Deals regular damage. Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Drill Run
moves.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.effect: Hits twice in one turn.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is in the first turn of Dig, this move will hit with double power.

moves.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.
moves.longEffect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Electro Shot
moves.effect: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.
moves.longEffect: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Encore
moves.effect: Forces the target to repeat its last used move every turn for 2 to 6 turns.
moves.longEffect:
The next 4–8 times (selected at random) the target attempts to move, it is forced to repeat its last used move. If the selected move allows the trainer to select a target, an opponent will be selected at random each turn. If the target is prevented from using the selected move by some other effect, Struggle will be used instead. This effect ends if the selected move runs out of PP.

If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if it does not know the selected move, or if the selected move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail. If the target’s last used move was Encore, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Struggle, or Transform, this move will fail.
notes: Locks the target into its last move for 3 turns.
Fails if the target has not moved yet, or is already locked (Bide, Outrage), or if the move has 0 PP left.
From a Prankster user the +1 priority does not apply against Dark-type targets (see the ability note).

moves.name: Endure
moves.effect: Prevents the user’s HP from lowering below 1 this turn.
moves.longEffect:
The user’s HP cannot be lowered below 1 by any means for the remainder of this turn.

If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Entrainment
moves.effect: Copies the user’s ability onto the target.
moves.longEffect: Changes the target’s ability to match the user’s. This effect ends when the target leaves battle.

moves.name: Eruption
moves.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.effect: If Psychic Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power incrased by 50%.
moves.longEffect: If Psychic Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power incrased by 50%.

moves.name: Explosion
moves.effect: User faints.
moves.longEffect: User faints, even if the attack fails or misses. Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Extreme Speed
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Facade
moves.effect: Power doubles if user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, this move has double power.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.effect: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle. Causes the target to flinch.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Causes the target to flinch. Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field.
notes: Only selectable on the user's first turn after switching in.
Flinch only lands on a target that has not moved yet this turn, so it does nothing into a faster foe.
Makes contact — triggers Rocky Helmet, Static, Flame Body, Rough Skin, etc.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
moves.longEffect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Feint
moves.effect: Hits through Protect and Detect.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. Removes the effects of Detect or Protect from the target before hitting.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Fell Stinger
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages if it KOs the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Attack by two stages if it KOs the target.

moves.name: Fiery Dance
moves.effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Final Gambit
moves.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s remaining HP. User faints.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s remaining HP. User faints.

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Fissure
moves.effect: Causes a one-hit KO.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Fling
moves.effect: Throws held item at the target; power depends on the item.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held item. The item is consumed. If the user is not holding an item, or its item has no set type and power, this move will fail.

This move ignores Sticky Hold.

If the user is under the effect of Embargo, this move will fail.

moves.name: Flip Turn
moves.effect: User must switch out after attacking.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

moves.name: Flower Trick
moves.effect: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.
moves.longEffect: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Follow Me
moves.effect: Redirects the target’s single-target effects to the user for this turn.
moves.longEffect:
Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user. If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target.

This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain.

If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.
notes: Redirects opponents’ single-target moves to the user; unlike Rage Powder it works on Grass types and Safety Goggles holders.

moves.name: Foul Play
moves.effect: Calculates damage with the target’s attacking stat.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Damage is calculated using the target’s attacking stat rather than the user’s.

moves.name: Freeze-Dry
moves.effect: Super-effective against Water.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. This move is super-effective against the Water type.

The target’s other type will affect damage as usual. If this move’s type is changed, it remains super-effective against Water regardless of its type.

moves.name: Frost Breath
moves.effect: Always scores a critical hit.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Gigaton Hammer
moves.effect: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.
moves.longEffect: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.

moves.name: Gravity
moves.effect: Disables moves and immunities that involve flying or levitating for five turns.
moves.longEffect:
For five turns (including this one), all immunities to Ground moves are disabled. For the duration of this effect, the evasion of every Pokémon on the field is lowered by two stages. Cancels the effects of Bounce, Fly, and Sky Drop.

Specifically, Flying Pokémon and those with Levitate or that have used Magnet Rise are no longer immune to Ground attacks, Arena Trap, Spikes, or Toxic Spikes.

Bounce, Fly, Sky Drop, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, and Splash cannot be used while this move is in effect.

*Bug*: If this move is used during a double or triple battle while Pokémon are under the effect of Sky Drop, Sky Drop’s effect is not correctly canceled on its target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely. As Sky Drop prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

moves.longEffect:
Every Pokémon is given a counter that starts at 3 and decreases by 1 at the end of every turn, including this one. When a Pokémon’s counter reaches zero, that Pokémon faints. A Pokémon that leaves the field will lose its counter; its replacement does not inherit the effect, and other Pokémon’s counters remain.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Protect
moves.effect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
moves.longEffect:
No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail.

Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move.

Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move.

The following effects are not prevented by this move:

* Acupressure from an ally
* Curse’s curse effect
* Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn
* Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits
* Imprison
* Perish Song
* Shadow Force
* Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.
notes: Consecutive protection moves share a success counter: the chance to succeed is 1, then 1/3, then 1/9, … halving-ish each turn, and resets when the user does anything else.
Does not block Feint, Shadow Force / Phantom Force, ally moves, or field effects like Perish Song and entry hazards.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.effect: Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s.
moves.longEffect:
Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s.

moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Psychic Fangs

moves.longEffect: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Rage Powder

moves.longEffect:
Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user. If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target.

This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain.

If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.
notes: Redirects single-target moves from opponents to the user in doubles.
Has no effect on Grass-type Pokémon, or on holders of Safety Goggles, or on users of Overcoat — those ignore the redirection.

moves.name: Rain Dance

moves.longEffect:
Changes the weather to rain for five turns, during which Water moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Fire moves inflict half damage.

If the user is holding Damp Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

Thunder has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Thunder has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

Solar Beam has half power.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP.

Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed.

Pokémon with Forecast become Water.

Pokémon with Dry Skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with Hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with Rain Dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.

moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.longEffect: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.longEffect:

This move fails if the Pokémon cannot fall asleep due to Uproar, Insomnia, or Vital Spirit. It also fails if the Pokémon is at full health or is already asleep.

moves.name: Rising Voltage
