moves.longEffect: If Electric Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its power doubled.

moves.name: Roar
moves.effect: Immediately ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
moves.longEffect:
Switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon selected at random. Wild battles end immediately.

Doesn’t affect Pokémon with Suction Cups or under the effect of Ingrain.

moves.name: Rock Blast
moves.effect: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Roost
moves.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.
moves.longEffect: Heals the user for half its max HP. If the user is Flying, its Flying type is ignored until the end of this turn.

moves.name: Round
moves.effect: Has double power if it’s used more than once per turn.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. If Round has already been used this turn, this move’s power is doubled. After this move is used, any other Pokémon using it this turn will immediately do so (in the order they would otherwise act), regardless of Speed or priority. Pokémon using other moves will then continue to act as usual.

moves.name: Sacred Sword
moves.effect: Ignores the target’s stat modifiers.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

moves.name: Salt Cure
moves.effect: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.
moves.longEffect: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.

moves.name: Scald
moves.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
moves.longEffect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Scorching Sands
moves.effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Shadow Claw
moves.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Shadow Sneak
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Shed Tail
moves.effect: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
moves.longEffect: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Sheer Cold
moves.effect: Causes a one-hit KO.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

moves.name: Shell Smash
moves.effect: Raises user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages. Lower user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Raises the user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages each. Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Simple Beam
moves.effect: Changes the target’s ability to Simple.
moves.longEffect: Changes the target’s ability to Simple.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.effect: User and target swap abilities.
moves.longEffect:
User and target switch abilities. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

If either Pokémon has Multitype or Wonder Guard, this move will fail.

moves.name: Slack Off
moves.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.
moves.longEffect: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.effect: Puts the target to sleep.
moves.longEffect: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Smack Down
moves.effect: Removes any immunity to Ground damage.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. Removes the target’s immunity to Ground-type damage. This effect removes any existing Ground immunity due to Levitate, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, and causes the target’s Flying type to be ignored when it takes Ground damage.

If the target isn’t immune to Ground damage, this move will fail.

This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, and ends the effect of Bounce or Fly.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Soak
moves.effect: Changes the target’s type to Water.
moves.longEffect: Changes the target to pure Water-type until it leaves the field. If the target has Multitype, this move will fail.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking.

During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Solar Blade
moves.effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking.

During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Speed Swap
moves.effect: Exchanges the user’s Speed with the target’s.
moves.longEffect: Exchanges the original Speed stats of the user and target.

moves.name: Spiky Shield
moves.effect: Blocks damaging attacks and damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP.
moves.longEffect: Blocks damaging attacks and damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP.

moves.name: Spirit Break
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.effect: Causes damage when opposing Pokémon switch in.
moves.longEffect:
Spreads sharp rocks around the opposing field, damaging any Pokémon that enters the field for 1/8 its max HP. This damage is affected by the entering Pokémon’s susceptibility to Rock moves.

Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field.

moves.name: Steel Beam
moves.effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

moves.name: Steel Roller
moves.effect: Ends the effect of Electric, Grassy, Misty, or Psychic Terrains. Fails if no Terrain is active.
moves.longEffect: Ends the effect of Electric, Grassy, Misty, or Psychic Terrains. Fails if no Terrain is active.

moves.name: Sticky Web
moves.effect: Covers the opposing field, lowering opponents’ Speed by one stage upon switching in.
moves.longEffect:
Shoots a web over the opponents’ side of the field, which lowers the Speed of any opposing Pokémon that enters the field by one stage.

Pokémon in the air, such as Flying-types and those with Levitate, are unaffected. Rapid Spin removes Sticky Web from the user’s side of the field; Defog removes it from both sides.

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.effect: Stores energy up to three times for use with Spit Up and Swallow.
moves.longEffect:
Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each. Stores energy for use with Spit Up and Swallow. Up to three levels of energy can be stored, and all are lost if the user leaves the field. Energy is still stored even if the stat boosts cannot be applied.

If the user uses Baton Pass, the stat boosts are passed as normal, but the stored energy is not.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.effect: Has double power if the user’s last move failed.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Power is doubled if the user’s last move failed for any reason (i.e., produced the message "But it failed!") or was ineffective due to types.

moves.name: Stone Axe
moves.effect: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.
moves.longEffect: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.effect: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised. Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power. For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.

moves.name: Storm Throw
moves.effect: Always scores a critical hit.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit.

moves.name: Strength Sap
moves.effect: Heals the user by the target’s current Attack stat and lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
moves.longEffect:
Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage. Heals the user by the target’s current Attack, including modifiers, but not including this move’s Attack-lowering effect.

If the target’s Attack is already at -6, this move will fail. In any other situation that would prevent a stat modification, the healing will still succeed.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.effect: Transfers 1/4 of the user’s max HP into a doll, protecting the user from further damage or status changes until it breaks.
moves.longEffect:
Transfers 1/4 the user’s max HP into a doll that absorbs damage and causes most negative move effects to fail. If the user leaves the field, the doll will vanish. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail.

The doll takes damage as normal, using the user’s stats and types, and will break when its HP reaches zero. Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed. Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal. Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the doll’s HP does not influence any move.

The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching. The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect. Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate.

Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche, Counter, or a Rowap Berry. Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block. Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal.

It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed, and Yawn. A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep.

The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist. If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked.

Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll.

The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes.

The doll is passed on by Baton Pass. It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation.

All other effects work as normal.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.effect: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target has not selected a damaging move this turn, or if the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

This move is not affected by Iron Fist.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.effect: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.
moves.longEffect:
Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which Fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Water moves inflict half damage.

If the user is holding Heat Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

Pokémon cannot become frozen.

Thunder has 50% accuracy.

Solar Beam skips its charge turn.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP.

Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed.

Pokémon with Forecast become Fire.

Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects.

Pokémon with Flower Gift change form; every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%.

Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn.

Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.effect: Inflicts damage equal to half the target’s HP.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.effect: Lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Surf
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.effect: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages and confuses the target.
moves.longEffect: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages, then confuses it. If the target’s Attack cannot be raised by two stages, the confusion is not applied.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.
moves.longEffect: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.effect: Heals the user by half its max HP. Affected by weather.
moves.longEffect:
Heals the user for half its max HP.

During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.effect: For three turns, friendly Pokémon have doubled Speed.
moves.longEffect: For the next three turns, all Pokémon on the user’s side of the field have their original Speed doubled. This effect remains if the user leaves the field.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.effect: For the next few turns, the target can only use damaging moves.
moves.longEffect:
Target is forced to only use damaging moves for the next 3–5 turns, selected at random. Moves that select other moves not known in advance do not count as damaging.

Assist, Copycat, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, and Sleep Talk do not directly inflict damage and thus may not be used.

Bide, Counter, Endeavor, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat are allowed.
notes: Stops the target selecting status moves for 3 turns.
From a Prankster user it does not gain priority against Dark-type targets.

moves.name: Temper Flare
moves.effect: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
moves.longEffect: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.effect: Prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Silences the target for two turns, preventing it from using any sound-based moves.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

During Rain Dance, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.

During Sunny Day, this move has 50% accuracy.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.effect: Paralyzes the target.
moves.longEffect: Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Topsy-Turvy
moves.effect: Inverts the target’s stat modifiers.
moves.longEffect: Inverts the target’s stat modifiers.

moves.name: Torch Song
moves.effect: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.longEffect: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.effect: Badly poisons the target, inflicting more damage every turn.
moves.longEffect: Badly poisons the target. Never misses when used by a Poison-type Pokémon.

moves.name: Trailblaze
moves.effect: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.
moves.longEffect: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Trick
moves.effect: User and target swap items.
moves.longEffect:
User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail.

If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail.

If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.effect: For five turns, slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon.
moves.longEffect:
For five turns (including this one), slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon. Move priority is not affected. Using this move when its effect is already active will end the effect.

Pokémon holding Full Incense, Lagging Tail, or Quick Claw and Pokémon with Stall ignore this effect.

moves.name: Triple Axel
moves.effect: Hits three times, increasing power by 100% with each successful hit.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits three times in the same turn. The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power. Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses.

Skill Link does not apply.
notes: Ramps in power across its three hits: 20 BP, then 40, then 60 (120 total if all land).
Each hit rolls its own 90% accuracy check and the move stops at the first miss. Loaded Dice removes the accuracy check on the 2nd and 3rd hits; Skill Link does not force all three.
Every hit is boosted (or resisted) independently, so it can break a Focus Sash or Substitute on an earlier hit and still KO.

moves.name: Trop Kick
moves.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Twin Beam
moves.effect: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
moves.longEffect: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.effect: User must switch out after attacking.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

moves.name: Upper Hand
moves.effect: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.
moves.longEffect: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.effect: User must switch out after attacking.
moves.longEffect:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

moves.name: Volt Tackle
moves.effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Water Shuriken
moves.effect: Hits 2–5 times.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times.

moves.name: Water Spout
moves.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Wave Crash
moves.effect: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.
moves.longEffect: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.effect: If there be weather, this move has doubled power and the weather’s type.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. If a weather move is active, this move has double power, and its type becomes the type of the weather move. Shadow Sky is typeless for the purposes of this move.

moves.name: Wide Guard
moves.effect: Prevents any multi-target moves from hitting friendly Pokémon this turn.
moves.longEffect:
Moves with multiple targets will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.effect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.effect: Burns the target.
moves.longEffect: Burns the target.
notes: Burn halves physical damage and chips 1/16 max HP per turn.
Fails into Fire types, Comatose, and holders of certain abilities (Water Veil, Thermal Exchange, Water Bubble). 85% accuracy — it can miss.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.effect: Target sleeps at the end of the next turn.
moves.longEffect:
Puts the target to sleep at the end of the next turn. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If the target leaves the field, this effect is canceled. If the target has a status effect when this move is used, this move will fail.

If the target is protected by Safeguard when this move is used, this move will fail.

Insomnia and Vital Spirit prevent the sleep if the target has either at the end of the next turn, but will not cause this move to fail on use.

moves.name: Zap Cannon
moves.effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.longEffect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

abilities.name: Adaptability
abilities.effect: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon inflicts twice as much damage with moves whose types match its own, rather than the usual same-type attack bonus of 1.5×.

abilities.name: Aerilate
abilities.effect: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Flying moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.
abilities.longEffect: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Flying-type moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

abilities.name: Armor Tail
abilities.effect: Prevents the opponent from using any moves that have priority, such as Quick Attack.
abilities.longEffect: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon’s head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.effect: Raises this Pokémon's Special Attack by one stage every time its HP drops below half.
abilities.longEffect: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move that causes its HP to drop below 50%, its Special Attack rises by one stage.

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.effect: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.longEffect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Fire-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.effect: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.
abilities.longEffect: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed during strong sunlight.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during strong sunlight.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

abilities.name: Clear Body
abilities.effect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon.

This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap.

This ability functions identically to White Smoke in battle.

abilities.name: Cloud Nine
abilities.effect: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
abilities.longEffect:
While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects.

This ability functions identically to Air Lock.

abilities.name: Competitive
abilities.effect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.
abilities.longEffect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.effect: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.3×.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their accuracy.

This ability has no effect on the one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold).

Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, the chance of a wild Pokémon holding a particular item is raised from 50%, 5%, or 1% to 60%, 20%, or 5%, respectively.

abilities.name: Contrary
abilities.effect: Inverts stat changes.
abilities.longEffect: Whenever this Pokémon's stats would be raised, they are instead lowered by the same amount, and vice versa.

abilities.name: Curious Medicine
abilities.effect: Resets all stat changes upon entering battlefield.
abilities.longEffect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

abilities.name: Cursed Body
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of Disabling any move that hits the Pokémon.
abilities.longEffect: Moves that hit this Pokémon have a 30% chance of being Disabled afterward.

abilities.name: Cute Charm
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.longEffect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being infatuated.

Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any wild Pokémon whose species can be either gender has a 2/3 chance of being set to the opposite gender, and a 1/3 chance of having a random gender as usual.

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.effect: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.
abilities.longEffect: While this Pokémon is in battle, Self-Destruct and Explosion will fail and Aftermath will not take effect.

abilities.name: Defiant
abilities.effect: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.
abilities.longEffect:
When any of this Pokémon's stats are lowered, its Attack rises by two stages.

If multiple stats are lowered at once, this ability takes effect with each stat lowered.

abilities.name: Disguise
abilities.effect: Prevents the first instance of battle damage.
abilities.longEffect:
If this Pokémon is in its Disguised Form and takes damage from a move, it switches to its Busted Form and the damage is prevented. Other effects are not prevented.

This ability cannot be copied or replaced. This ability only takes effect for Mimikyu.

abilities.name: Drizzle
abilities.effect: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
abilities.longEffect:
The weather changes to rain when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless replaced by another weather condition.

If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drought, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

abilities.name: Drought
abilities.effect: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
abilities.longEffect:
The weather changes to strong sunlight when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition.

If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

abilities.name: Effect Spore
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.longEffect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed, poisoned, or put to sleep, chosen at random.

Nothing is done to compensate if the move's user is immune to one of these ailments; there is simply a lower chance that the move's user will be affected.

abilities.name: Electric Surge
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Electric Terrain.
abilities.longEffect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Electric Terrain.

abilities.name: Electromorphosis
abilities.effect: When hit by an attack, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.
abilities.longEffect: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

abilities.name: Fairy Aura
abilities.effect: Strengthens Fairy moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.
abilities.longEffect: Strengthens Fairy moves for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.

abilities.name: Filter
abilities.effect: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it.

This ability functions identically to Solid Rock.

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.longEffect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being burned.

Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Magma Armor.
notes: 30% chance to burn a Pokémon that hits the holder with a contact move.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.effect: Protects against Fire moves. Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon is immune to Fire-type moves. Once this Pokémon has been hit by a Fire move, its own Fire moves will inflict 1.5× as much damage until it leaves battle.

This ability has no effect while the Pokémon is frozen. The Fire damage bonus is retained even if the Pokémon is frozen and thawed or the ability is lost or disabled. Fire moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This ability takes effect even on non-damaging moves, i.e. Will-O-Wisp.

abilities.name: Fluffy
abilities.effect: Damage from contact moves is halved. Damage from Fire moves is doubled.
abilities.longEffect: Damage from contact moves is halved. Damage from Fire moves is doubled.

abilities.name: Friend Guard
abilities.effect: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.
abilities.longEffect:
All friendly Pokémon take 0.75× as much direct damage from moves while this Pokémon is in battle.

This effect stacks if multiple allied Pokémon have it.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.effect: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.
abilities.longEffect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals an opposing Pokémon's held item to all participating trainers.

In a double battle, if one opponent has an item, this Pokémon will Frisk that Pokémon; if both have an item, it will Frisk one at random.

abilities.name: Gale Wings
abilities.effect: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.
abilities.longEffect: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.

abilities.name: Gluttony
abilities.effect: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon eats any held Berry triggered by low HP when it falls below 50% of its HP, regardless of the Berry's usual threshold.

abilities.name: Good as Gold
abilities.effect: Gives immunity to status moves.
abilities.longEffect: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon’s status moves.
notes: The holder is immune to status moves targeted at it — Will-O-Wisp, Thunder Wave, Spore, Parting Shot, Toxic, Encore, Trick, etc.
Does not block Intimidate, entry hazards, weather, Terrain, or damaging moves with secondary effects.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.effect: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
abilities.longEffect:
Whenever this Pokémon is asleep, burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, it has 1.5× its Attack. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Attack cut from a burn.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

abilities.name: Healer
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.
abilities.longEffect: Friendly Pokémon next to this Pokémon in double and triple battles each have a 30% chance of being cured of any major status ailment after each turn.

abilities.name: Heatproof
abilities.effect: Halves damage from Fire moves and burns.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire-type moves and burns.

abilities.name: Heavy Metal
abilities.effect: Doubles the Pokémon's weight.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon has double the usual weight for its species.

abilities.name: Hospitality
abilities.effect: When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.
abilities.longEffect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.

abilities.name: Huge Power
abilities.effect: Doubles Attack in battle.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon's Attack is doubled while in battle.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

This ability functions identically to Pure Power.

abilities.name: Illusion
abilities.effect: Takes the appearance of the last conscious party Pokémon upon being sent out until hit by a damaging move.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon, upon being sent out, appears to have the species, nickname, and Poké Ball of the last Pokémon in the party that is able to battle. This illusion breaks upon being hit by a damaging move.

Other damage, e.g. from weather or Spikes, does not break the illusion, nor does damage done to a Substitute.

If the party order becomes temporarily shuffled around as Pokémon are switched out in battle, this ability chooses the last Pokémon according to that shuffled order.

abilities.name: Immunity
abilities.effect: Prevents poison.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon cannot be poisoned. This includes bad poison.

If a Pokémon is poisoned and acquires this ability, its poison is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.effect: Bypasses Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon's moves ignore Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.effect: Prevents flinching.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon cannot flinch.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.effect: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.
abilities.longEffect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, the opponent's Attack is lowered by one stage. In a double battle, both opponents are affected.

This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle, but will not take effect again if lost and reobtained without leaving battle.

This ability has no effect on an opponent that has a Substitute.

Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.
notes: Lowers the Attack of both opposing Pokémon by one stage on switch-in.

Blocked or punished by Clear Body, Hyper Cutter, White Smoke, Full Metal Body, Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, Scrappy (Gen 8+), Guard Dog (raises Attack instead), Rattled (raises Speed), and Defiant / Competitive (sharp offensive boost). Mirror Armor reflects the drop back onto the Intimidate user.

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.effect: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.
abilities.longEffect:
Moves flagged as being punch-based have 1.2× their base power for this Pokémon.

Sucker Punch is not flagged as punch-based; its original, Japanese name only means "surprise attack".

abilities.name: Justified
abilities.effect: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.
abilities.longEffect:
Whenever a Dark-type move hits this Pokémon, its Attack rises one stage.

The move is not negated in any way.

abilities.name: Leaf Guard
abilities.effect: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon cannot be given a major status ailment during strong sunlight.

This ability does not heal prior status ailments. Rest will fail altogether with this ability in effect. Yawn will immediately fail if used on this Pokémon during strong sunlight, and an already-used Yawn will fail if the weather turns to strong sunlight in the meantime.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.effect: Evades Ground moves.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon is immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Arena Trap.

This ability is disabled during Gravity or Ingrain, or while holding an Iron Ball. This ability is not disabled during Roost.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.effect: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.
abilities.longEffect:
All other Pokémon's single-target Electric-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon if it is an eligible target. Other Pokémon's Electric moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it.

If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow Me takes precedence over this ability.

If the Pokémon is a Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves, its immunity prevents the Special Attack boost.

abilities.name: Liquid Voice
abilities.effect: Sound-based moves become Water-type.
abilities.longEffect: When this Pokémon uses a move that is sound-based, that move's type is Water.

abilities.name: Magic Bounce
abilities.effect: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.
abilities.longEffect:
When this Pokémon is targeted by a move flagged as being reflectable, the move is redirected to its user.

All reflectable moves are non-damaging, and most non-damaging moves that target other Pokémon are reflectable.

A move reflected by this ability or Magic Coat cannot be reflected back.

abilities.name: Magic Guard
abilities.effect: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon is immune to damage not directly caused by a move.

For example, this Pokémon takes no damage from from weather, recoil, status ailments, or Spikes, but it still suffers from the Attack cut when burned, and a Life Orb will still power up this Pokémon's moves without damaging it. Anything that directly depends on such damage will also not happen; for example, Leech Seed will neither hurt this Pokémon nor heal the opponent, and Pokémon with a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry will not consume the berry when hit by this Pokémon.

The following are unaffected: Struggle, Pain Split (whether used by or against this Pokémon), Belly Drum, Substitute, Curse, moves that knock the user out, and damage from confusion.

This Pokémon will neither lose nor regain HP if it drains HP from a Pokémon with Liquid Ooze.

If this Pokémon is badly poisoned, the poison counter is still increased each turn; if the Pokémon loses this ability, it will begin taking as much damage as it would be if it had been taking increasing damage each turn.

abilities.name: Mega Launcher
abilities.effect: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.
abilities.longEffect: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.

abilities.name: Mega Sol
abilities.effect: The Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
abilities.longEffect: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

abilities.name: Mirror Armor
abilities.effect: Reflects any stat-lowering effects.
abilities.longEffect: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.effect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target.

For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way.

Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle. This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all.

An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed.

When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability.

This ability functions identically to Teravolt and Turboblaze.

abilities.name: Moxie
abilities.effect: Raises Attack one stage upon KOing a Pokémon.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon's Attack rises one stage upon knocking out another Pokémon, even a friendly Pokémon.

This ability does not take effect when the Pokémon indirectly causes another Pokémon to faint, e.g. through poison or Spikes.

If this Pokémon knocks out a Pokémon with Mummy, the former's ability will change without taking effect.

abilities.name: Multiscale
abilities.effect: Halves damage taken from full HP.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon takes half as much damage when it is hit having full HP.

abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.effect: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment when it is switched out for another Pokémon.

If this ability is acquired during battle, the Pokémon is cured upon leaving battle before losing the temporary ability.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.effect: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.
abilities.longEffect:
Moves used by or against this Pokémon never miss.

One-hit KO moves are unaffected. Moves affected by this ability can hit Pokémon during the preparation turn of moves like Dig or Fly.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.effect: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon cannot be infatuated and is immune to Captivate.

If a Pokémon is infatuated and acquires this ability, its infatuation is cleared.

abilities.name: Overcoat
abilities.effect: Protects against damage from weather.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon does not take damage from weather.

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.effect: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.longEffect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Grass-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.effect: Prevents confusion.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon cannot be confused.

If a Pokémon is confused and acquires this ability, its confusion will immediately be healed.

abilities.name: Parental Bond
abilities.effect: Lets the bearer hit twice with damaging moves. The second hit has half power.
abilities.longEffect: Lets the bearer hit twice with damaging moves. The second hit has half power.

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.effect: Steals attacking Pokémon's held items on contact.
abilities.longEffect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, if it does not have a held item, it steals the attacker's held item.

This Pokémon cannot steal upon being knocked out. It can steal if the attacker has a Substitute, but cannot steal when its own Substitute is hit. If a move hits multiple times, only the last hit triggers this ability. If this Pokémon is wild, it cannot steal from a trained Pokémon.

abilities.name: Piercing Drill
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves.
abilities.longEffect: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.

abilities.name: Pixilate
abilities.effect: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Fairy moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.
abilities.longEffect: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Fairy moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

abilities.name: Plus
abilities.effect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.longEffect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

abilities.name: Poison Touch
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning target Pokémon upon contact.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning the target with each hit.

This counts as an extra effect for the purposes of Shield Dust. This ability takes effect before Mummy.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.effect: Raises non-damaging moves' priority by one stage.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by one stage.
notes: Gives +1 priority to the holder’s status (non-damaging) moves.

Since Gen 7, a Prankster-boosted status move fails outright against Dark-type Pokémon — a Prankster user cannot Encore, Taunt, Thunder Wave, Spore, etc. a Dark type by way of the priority. Using the same move without the priority boost (e.g. a Dark type ignoring Prankster) still works.
The boosted move is also stopped by an opponent’s Psychic Terrain if the target is grounded.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.effect: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.
abilities.longEffect:
Moves targetting this Pokémon use one extra PP.

This ability stacks if multiple targets have it. This ability still affects moves that fail or miss. This ability does not affect ally moves that target either the entire field or just its side, nor this Pokémon's self-targetted moves; it does, however, affect single-targetted ally moves aimed at this Pokémon, ally moves that target all other Pokémon, and opponents' moves that target the entire field. If this ability raises a move's PP cost above its remaining PP, it will use all remaining PP.

When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.

abilities.name: Protean
abilities.effect: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses.
abilities.longEffect:
Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses.

The type change takes place just before the move is used.

abilities.name: Pure Power
abilities.effect: Doubles Attack in battle.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon's Attack is doubled in battle.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

This ability functions identically to Huge Power.

abilities.name: Purifying Salt
abilities.effect: Protects from status conditions and halves damage from Ghost-type moves.
abilities.longEffect: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

abilities.name: Queenly Majesty
abilities.effect: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.
abilities.longEffect: When an opposing Pokémon attempts to use a move that targets this Pokémon or an ally, and that move has priority, it will fail.

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during rain.

abilities.name: Reckless
abilities.effect: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon's recoil moves and crash moves have 1.2× their base power.

Struggle is unaffected.

The "crash moves" are the moves that damage the user upon missing: Jump Kick and High Jump Kick.

abilities.name: Refrigerate
abilities.effect: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Ice moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.
abilities.longEffect: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Ice-type moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon regains 1/3 of its maximum HP when it is switched out for another Pokémon under any circumstances other than having fainted.

This ability does not take effect when a battle ends.
notes: Restores 1/3 of max HP whenever the holder switches out.

abilities.name: Rock Head
abilities.effect: Protects against recoil damage.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon does not receive recoil damage from its recoil moves.

Struggle's recoil is unaffected. This ability does not prevent crash damage from missing with Jump Kick or High Jump Kick.

abilities.name: Rough Skin
abilities.effect: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.
abilities.longEffect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage.

This ability functions identically to Iron Barbs.

abilities.name: Sand Force
abilities.effect: Strengthens Rock, Ground, and Steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.
abilities.longEffect: During a sandstorm, this Pokémon's Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves have 1.3× their base power. This Pokémon does not take sandstorm damage, regardless of type.

abilities.name: Sand Rush
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during a sandstorm, and it does not take sandstorm damage, regardless of type.

abilities.name: Sand Stream
abilities.effect: Summons a sandstorm that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
abilities.longEffect:
The weather changes to a sandstorm when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition.

If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.

abilities.name: Sand Veil
abilities.effect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.
abilities.longEffect:
During a sandstorm, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take sandstorm damage regardless of type.

The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.effect: Absorbs Grass moves, raising Attack one stage.
abilities.longEffect: Whenever a Grass-type move hits this Pokémon, its Attack rises one stage, negating any other effect on it.

abilities.name: Scrappy
abilities.effect: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon ignores Ghost-type Pokémon's immunity to Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

Ghost Pokémon's other types affect damage as usual.

abilities.name: Shadow Tag
abilities.effect: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.
abilities.longEffect:
While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out.

Other Pokémon with this ability are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.

abilities.name: Sharpness
abilities.effect: Powers up slicing moves.
abilities.longEffect: Increases the power of all 'slicing' moves by 50%.

abilities.name: Sheer Force
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon's moves with extra effects have 1.3× their power, but lose their extra effects.

An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate.

Moves that lower the user's stats are unaffected.

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.effect: Protects against critical hits.
abilities.longEffect:
Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon.

This ability functions identically to Battle Armor.

abilities.name: Shield Dust
abilities.effect: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon is immune to the extra effects of moves used against it.

An extra effect is a move's chance, listed as an "effect chance", to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate.

abilities.name: Skill Link
abilities.effect: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and Triple Kick to their full length every time.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon always hits five times with two-to-five-hit moves, such as Icicle Spear. It also bypasses the accuracy checks on Triple Kick's second and third hits.

abilities.name: Snow Cloak
abilities.effect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail. Protects against hail damage.
abilities.longEffect:
During hail, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type.

The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in snow.

abilities.name: Snow Warning
abilities.effect: Summons hail that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.
abilities.longEffect:
The weather changes to hail when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition.

If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Sand Stream are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

abilities.name: Solar Power
abilities.effect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.
abilities.longEffect: During strong sunlight, this Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack but takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn.

abilities.name: Soundproof
abilities.effect: Protects against sound-based moves.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon is immune to moves flagged as being sound-based.

Heal Bell is unaffected. Uproar still prevents this Pokémon from sleeping. This Pokémon can still receive a Perish Song counter through Baton Pass, and will retain a Perish Song counter if it acquires this ability after Perish Song is used.

Howl, Roar of Time, Sonic Boom, and Yawn are not flagged as sound-based.

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.effect: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage after each turn.

abilities.name: Spicy Spray
abilities.effect: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
abilities.longEffect: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

abilities.name: Stalwart
abilities.effect: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.
abilities.longEffect: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

abilities.name: Stamina
abilities.effect: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.
abilities.longEffect: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.

abilities.name: Stance Change
abilities.effect: Changes Aegislash to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using King’s Shield.
abilities.longEffect: Changes Aegislash to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using King’s Shield.

abilities.name: Static
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.longEffect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed.

Pokémon that are immune to Electric-type moves can still be paralyzed by this ability.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, there is a 50% chance that encounters will be with an Electric Pokémon, if applicable.

abilities.name: Strong Jaw
abilities.effect: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.
abilities.longEffect: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.effect: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead. Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.
abilities.longEffect:
When this Pokémon is at full HP, any hit that would knock it out will instead leave it with 1 HP. Regardless of its current HP, it is also immune to the one-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold.

If this Pokémon is holding a Focus Sash, this ability takes precedence and the item will not be consumed.

abilities.name: Super Luck
abilities.effect: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon's moves have critical hit rates one stage higher than normal.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.effect: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.longEffect:
When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Bug-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is increased.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed during rain.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during rain.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.effect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.
abilities.longEffect:
Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment.

This ability passes back bad poison when this Pokémon is badly poisoned. This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from Toxic Spikes or the burn from a Flame Orb.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature. This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries.

abilities.name: Technician
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less.

This includes moves of variable power, such as Hidden Power and Magnitude, when their power is 60 or less. Helping Hand's power boost is taken into account for any move, as is Defense Curl's power boost for Rollout.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.effect: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon does not take damage from friendly Pokémon's moves, including single-target moves aimed at it.

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.effect: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.
abilities.longEffect: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.effect: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.longEffect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Water-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

abilities.name: Tough Claws
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.
abilities.longEffect: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.

abilities.name: Toxic Debris
abilities.effect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
abilities.longEffect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

abilities.name: Trace
abilities.effect: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.
abilities.longEffect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, it copies a random opponent's ability.

This ability cannot copy Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode.

abilities.name: Unaware
abilities.effect: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.
abilities.longEffect:
This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for the purposes of damage and accuracy calculation.

Effectively, this affects modifiers of every stat except Speed.

The power of Punishment and Stored Power is calculated as usual. When this Pokémon hurts itself in confusion, its stat modifiers affect damage as usual.

abilities.name: Unburden
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.
abilities.longEffect:
When this Pokémon uses or loses its held item, its Speed is doubled. If it gains another item or leaves battle, this bonus is lost.

This includes when the Pokémon drops its item because of Knock Off. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. There is no notification when this ability takes effect.

abilities.name: Unnerve
abilities.effect: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.
abilities.longEffect:
Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle.

Affected Pokémon can still use Bug Bite or Pluck to eat a target's Berry.
notes: Opposing Pokémon cannot eat their Berries while the Unnerve user is on the field (also suppresses Booster Energy on switch-in for the turn it matters, and pairs with Neutralizing Gas discussions — but Unnerve only touches Berries).

abilities.name: Water Bubble
abilities.effect: Halves damage from Fire moves, doubles damage of Water moves, and prevents burns.
abilities.longEffect: When this Pokémon is hit by a Fire move, the damage is halved. When this Pokémon uses a Water move, the power is doubled. This Pokémon cannot be burned, and if it becomes burned, the burn is immediately cured.

abilities.name: Weak Armor
abilities.effect: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.
abilities.longEffect:
Whenever a physical move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage and its Defense falls one stage.

This ability triggers on every hit of a multiple-hit move.

abilities.name: Zero to Hero
abilities.effect: Transforms into its Hero Form when switching out.
abilities.longEffect: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
